children: JR Kyushu plans to work with SBI Holdings to launch an integrated financial app under its own brand in the 2027 fiscal year. According to Foresight News, the app will use infrastructure developed by SBI and initially provide banking services through an agency model before expanding into securities and crypto assets.

The app is expected to connect with the SUGOCA transit IC card and the JR Qupo points program. It will award points based on deposit balances and other criteria, and JR Kyushu is also considering whether points earned through rail and other services could be used to buy stocks or invest in funds.

title: JR Kyushu Plans Financial App With SBI Holdings for 2027 Fiscal Year Launch
